name: test_TC018_long_title_truncation[chromium]
description:
A card with a title >80 chars must not overflow its container.

    A long-title meeting is seeded in create_auth_state so this test always runs.
    We search for the seeded title by scanning each card's full text content,
    which avoids being brittle about which child element carries the title.
